views.label: Turn
views.note: The default: a cross turns round the grid, the e's a frame ahead of the a's; at rest, aerea across and down.

views.label: Radiate
views.note: Eight spokes open from the r out, hold, then clear from the centre out until the r rests alone; the still is the first ring of e's.

views.label: Diagonal
views.note: The cross turned 45 degrees: aerea on both diagonals.

views.label: Eight spokes
views.note: All eight spokes at once: every line through the r, across, down and on the diagonals, spells aerea.

views.label: Detail, 1.7×
views.note: The r and its ring of e's: the same gap of ink across, down and on the diagonal.

views.label: Three letters
views.note: Three letters turning, so the a's and e's trade sides; the still is the half step between two crosses.

views.label: Three letters, cross
views.note: The still cross in three letters: are across, era down.

views.label: Grid
views.note: Eight spokes over the grid: square cells as wide as the average letter plus the face's own gap.

views.label: Black
views.note: Eight spokes in white on black.
